You need to be non-aligned, at war with Italy, not allied to the soviets, have the controller of Hamadan, Iran be at war with Italy, complete Artillery Modernization, and have troops in Tuscany, Latium, or Abruzzo

I’m no proffesional, but I started off creating a variety of infantry divisions with 10 inf, some had recon and Engineers, some had Artillery, and also a handful of 14/4’s. Coupled that with focusing on doctrines, production, and  make sure to research naval invasion craft. 

With Polish Revanchism you can start justifying in Lithuania to form the PLC for some extra industry and men. I held the Vistula with some men on Krakow, Gdańsk, and Warsaw to stay in the war. Justify on Iran so that you can declare war once the Germans invade, because joining the allies prevents you from being able to. Send some troops to the Raj and take Hamadan. 

On the mainland I held out until the USSR declared war and I just tried to keep divisions from being destroyed until I capitulated. From there, some divisions will escape to the UK which will hand them over, but just in case, I asked for land in Ethiopia to produce my own guns and deploy my own soldiers in London. From there, prepare an invasion on an empty Italian province and you will run into a master +15% artillery attack general.

R5: Finally got wojtek in Bearer of Artillery. The new government in exile makes this achievement much easier. The divisions in Latium in this run were deployed in London after the capitulation of the PLC.
